subject: Information Theory
title: Entropy Rate of a Process
description: A fast breakdown of Entropy Rate of a Process for builders.

hook.text: English seems random letter by letter. But after 'th', the next letter is almost always 'e'. Patterns lower the rate.

buildup.text: Entropy rate is the per-symbol entropy of a stochastic process as the sequence grows long.

discovery.text: For an independent source, the rate equals single-symbol entropy. For a correlated one, it's lower.

twist.text: Markov chains have simple entropy rates: only the current state matters, not the full history.

climax.text: The entropy rate sets the ultimate compression limit for a source. No codec can beat it.

punchline.text: Patterns lower entropy rate. More compression follows.

quiz.question: What does a lower entropy rate indicate?
